scope: Input-only sizing of entire fixed-FA factory spaces and a necessary fatigue-inversion condition. No search, outcome sampling, fitness labels, operator changes or promotion of a failed mechanism.
stateSpace: For each of all4 old families, raw n!*(M*W)^n. Sufficient exact-physics resource classes by base/energy/labor across all jobs and other resources, worker alpha/mu/beta/h0 included. Stage0 label symmetry is only an enumeration quotient, not a new donor-normalization search proposal. Reconstructed standby is constant1; later stages are independent of stage0 resource IDs.
sizeFlags: Per-factory<=200000 and whole-family sum<=500000 are computational planning flags only, chosen before counts, not scientific performance or quality gates.
monotonicity: Exact rational product of exported double coefficients q=b*beta*mu; q<=1 suffices for single-operation completion monotonicity for h<=1. q>1 is potential only; no actual state sampled.
limits: Finite signatures may miss additional symmetries. Objective equivalence under relabeling still needs full physical QA before reduced enumeration. No single-FA reachability or algorithm advantage follows.
